node_definition.done_when: Done when tests/test_an_unfinished_promotion_is_retried.py builds, on a temporary crew home and repository, a run with a live pointer, a pending-landing record written by a promotion whose lease has been released, and no promoted ledger row. It asserts that one pass of the station's pending-landing sweep leaves the run either landed, or promotable with the stale record cleared. A second case, with the lease still held by a live holder, is left alone. Negative control: at the base revision the first case is left with its record, its pointer and no retry. The test files importing the changed modules add no failure against base in matched arms run as an all_debug partition job submitted with env -u SLURM_JOB_ID -u SLURM_JOBID sbatch , never on the fleet node. Each arm's log sits under the run directory, opens with its revision and literal command, and ends in EXIT= . ruff check and ruff format --check add no finding on the staged paths.
